title: Sprouty's Secret to Growing Tall
mascot_sheet: Character model sheet of Sprouty, a tiny anthropomorphic plant mascot for 2D animation. Sprouty is a lovable green seedling sprout rooted in a classic terracotta flower pot. He has a round pale-green head, two bouncy leaf hair tufts on top, giant sparkly anime cartoon eyes, rosy cheeks, and small flexible green arms. Full-body front view standing centered on a plain white background, bold clean outlines, vibrant flat colors, modern cutout cartoon style.
voice: Fast, bright, playful, and energetic youthful delivery with crisp cartoon comedic timing.
music: Bouncy and lighthearted cartoon pop instrumental with playful pizzicato and whistle melody at 126 BPM, sitting softly under the voiceover.
